# Redesign 2026-10: before and after

Each image is the same route and viewport, before the redesign on the left and
after on the right: phone at 390×844, desktop at 1440×900 (shown at half
size). Returning-visitor state (no boot screen, no tour), default theme. The landing
page keeps its long form, so it has no pair.
